title: Skyscraper complex acyclicity preservation
statement: For a ringed space X, point x and stalk-module cochain complex M, if M is acyclic then its termwise ringed-module skyscraper complex is acyclic.

source.place: the sectionwise exactness argument in the proof of lem-pc-skyscraper-complex

proof.text: Check exactness degreewise on every open: opens containing x give the exact sequence of M, while opens avoiding x give the zero sequence; sectionwise exactness implies sheaf acyclicity.

proof_origin.place: Definition Tag 009A (case (4)) and Lemma Tag 009C, applied degreewise; sectionwise exactness argument

mathlib_searches.query: skyscraper sheaf complex is acyclic if and only if its stalk complex is acyclic
mathlib_searches.results: HomologicalComplex acyclicity declarations, but no theorem for skyscraper sheaves of modules; only general C-valued skyscraper constructions.
Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Skyscraper.lean has C-valued skyscraper stalk declarations but no O_X-module complex theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem skyscraper_complex_acyclic (X : RingedSpace.{u_complex}) (x : X)
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u_complex} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ℤ) :
    M.Acyclic → (((ringedModuleSkyscraperFunctor X x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M).Acyclic
